title: Pre-launch gaps
when_to_use: Site not launched, missing pages, go-live checklist, what am I missing before launch.
principles: Verify with tools — do not invent missing pages or plugin lists.
Prioritize by launch risk: visibility (blog_public), HTTPS/health, contact/forms, legal pages, SEO presence, broken/empty key pages.
Distinguish “not launched” (discourage indexing) from “live but incomplete”.
Give a short ranked checklist with effort hints; ask which item to tackle first.
steps: get-site-snapshot + get-site-health for stack and health signal.
get-option for blog_public (0 = discourage search engines), show_on_front / page_on_front, permalink_structure.
list-content / search-content for Contact, About, Privacy, Terms, Home; note drafts vs published.
list-plugins for forms, SEO, security, caching, ecommerce — note gaps without installing everything at once.
Optional: find-unused-media / list-post-types for cleanup and CPT inventory.
Summarize top gaps (≈5–10), impact vs effort; offer to fix one with tools + HITL.
anti_patterns: A generic launch checklist with no tool results.
Installing a pile of plugins before confirming need.
Claiming the site is “ready” without checking blog_public and critical pages.
